data.name: Shayanun
data.long_meaning: The one who is given, The one who is bestowed

in_arabic.name: شَيانٌ
in_arabic.long_meaning: شَيانٌ هو اسم علم مذكر عربي الأصل، ويُشتق من الفعل شيّنَ، الذي يعني رفع الشأن أو الكرامة، ويتعلق بالكرامة والشرف والجلالة، وهو من الأسماء المُستخدمة في الثقافة الإسلامية منذ العصور الوسطى

in_urdu.name: شایان
in_urdu.long_meaning: شایان نام کا مطلب ہے عالی شان والا شخص، اور یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا تعلق شان و شوکت سے ہے، اور یہ نام پاکستان اور ہندوستان میں بکثرت استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: शायन
in_hindi.long_meaning: शायन नाम का अर्थ है महान व्यक्ति, और यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका संबंध सम्मान और गरिमा से है, और यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमानों में बहुत आम है

in_pashto.name: شایان
in_pashto.long_meaning: شایان نوم معنا دی لوړ شان سړی، او دا نوم عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی، چې د شان او شرافتیا سره اړیکه لري، او دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کې ډېر کارول کیږي

in_english.name: Shayanun
in_english.long_meaning: Shayanun is a name that means noble and dignified person, derived from Arabic roots, related to honor and prestige, and is used in Islamic culture to signify a person of high moral character and spiritual significance

data.cultural_impact: The name "Shayanun" is a beautiful Arabic name that is derived from the root word "Shaa- Ayin- Naun", which means "to give" or "to bestow." This name holds a significant cultural impact as it is believed to represent the idea of God's grace and mercy. In Muslim culture, it is common for parents to choose names for their children that reflect Islamic values and virtues. The name "Shayanun" embodies the notion of being granted blessings and gifts from Allah, which is a frequently recurring theme in the Quran.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Shayanun" holds deep significance as it symbolizes Allah's generosity and kindness towards His creation. It is a reminder of the fact that all blessings come from Allah, and that even the smallest of gifts are a manifestation of His divine will. Furthermore, the name "Shayanun" can serve as a source of inspiration for individuals to strive towards being givers themselves, emulating Allah's gift-giving nature by extending kindness, generosity, and compassion to others.
